title: Pure Prank-Kids
summary: Prank-Kids cards only, with generic Links and staples. Prank-Kids is a Fusion and Link deck of four Main Deck kids. Each kid, when used as material for a Prank-Kids Fusion or Link, summons another Prank-Kids monster from the hand or Deck. Lampsies burns, Dropsies gains LP, Fansies mills a Prank-Kids card first, and Rocksies, the newest legal card, draws. Prank-Kids Dodo-Doodle-Doo searches a Prank-Kids Spell/Trap. The Links and Fusions then tribute themselves on either turn to recover or revive two kids. Prank-Kids Plan Link Summons on either turn, and Prank-Kids Pandemonium Fusion Summons. Prank-Kids Battle Butler wipes their monsters and Prank-Kids Rip-Roarin-Roaster their Spells and Traps. Prank-Kids Meow-Meow-Mu is Forbidden.
